pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark patches with moderate edge angularity. Pixel gradients at patch boundaries are distinct but softened by low resolution. Patches on the mid-flank are larger and more elongated than those on the lower neck and ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream inter-patch pathways forming a semi-continuous grid. Junction nodes predominantly exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing at the contact points between large dorsal patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background. Individual hair clusters create a consistent serrated edge profile from the upper neck to the shoulder.
